newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums rise 50 cts, outright prices up.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums rise 50 cts, outright prices up.

text.p: Jet prices were over $2 a tonne stronger on Thursday.
The IPE gas oil contract climbed $1.75 while premiums for jet rose 50 cents to $19 above the IPE for barges and $19.50 for cargoes cif basis Rotterdam.
"Nobody was buying today but I got a lot of people just checking to see if I had any product," said a trader at a refinery selling jet barges.
He expected buying to emerge over the next few days.
Swaps also edged up 50 cents to $19.75 to $20 a tonne for June cargoes.
